description: Header file defining the CryptoHalHidl class, which implements the ICrypto interface for Android's DRM system using HIDL. It declares methods for plugin management, decryption, and session handling, and includes external DRM and HIDL dependencies.

classes.name: CryptoHalHidl
classes.description: Implements the ICrypto interface for Android DRM using HIDL, providing methods for plugin creation, decryption, session management, and logging.

methods.name: initCheck
methods.description: Checks initialization status of the crypto plugin.

methods.name: isCryptoSchemeSupported
methods.description: Checks if a given crypto scheme UUID is supported.

methods.name: createPlugin
methods.description: Creates a crypto plugin for a given UUID with optional init data.

methods.name: requiresSecureDecoderComponent
methods.description: Checks if a secure decoder component is required for a given MIME type.

methods.name: notifyResolution
methods.description: Notifies the plugin of video resolution changes.

methods.name: setHeap
methods.description: Sets the memory heap for crypto operations.

methods.name: getLogMessages
methods.description: Retrieves log messages from the crypto system.

methods.name: makeCryptoFactories
methods.description: Creates a list of crypto factory instances.

methods.name: makeCryptoPlugin
methods.description: Creates a crypto plugin instance for a given factory and UUID.
